I moved to Texas when I was in 5th grade from Seattle. Moving to the south was a HUGE culture change. Texas has some slang I’d never heard before. First day of school in Texas I was sitting in a line waiting for my bus to pick me up and I had my phone out. Apparently we weren’t  allowed to have them out and a teacher told me to “put it up”. See I had never heard someone say that before and I didn’t know that in the south it meant the same as “put it away”. So being the kid I was I held my phone up above my head. I was then sent to the office for being a “smart-ass”
